title: Evaluating the intensity of fire at the Acheulian site of Gesher Benot Ya'aqov—Spatial and thermoluminescence analyses
lineage: Original thermoluminescence measurements on a transect within Layer II-6 Level 2. Two coauthors later coauthored the 2022 fish study. The flint measurements address the localization of heating within one horizon.

passages.note: The southeast burnt-flint concentration is mapped from 563 burnt flint microartifacts. The thermoluminescence samples are from a transect running from the concentration's centre to its outskirts.

passages.locator: Results and Discussion, Table 3 and Fig. 4
passages.quote: fire intensity appears to decrease with distance from the hearth’s center.
passages.note: Four of five visually burnt pieces in the nearest square fell into the highest heating category versus none of three in the farthest square. The authors caution that the sample is small.
